components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 0.75rem); background: var(--primary, oklch(0.5 0.155 175)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.985 0.003 175)); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25rem var(--font-sans, "Geist Variable", sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, oklch(0.5 0.155 175)) 80%, transparent); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.6 0.16 175)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 0.75rem); background: var(--secondary, oklch(0.97 0 0)); color: var(--secondary-foreground, oklch(0.205 0 0)); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25rem var(--font-sans, "Geist Variable", sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--secondary, oklch(0.97 0 0)) 80%, transparent); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.6 0.16 175)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { height: 2rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--input, oklch(0.65 0 0)); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 0.75rem); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.21 0.008 175)); font: 400 0.875rem/1.25rem var(--font-sans, "Geist Variable", sans-serif); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.6 0.16 175)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.6 0.16 175)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.6 0.16 175)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Card
components.html:
Quarterly report

Updated two days ago.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-xl, 0.875rem); background: var(--card, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--card-foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground, oklch(0.21 0.008 175)) 10%, transparent); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Geist Variable", sans-serif); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-card-description { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.45 0.012 175)); } .ds-card:hover { background: var(--muted, oklch(0.967 0.005 175)); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.6 0.16 175)) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 1.25rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border-radius: var(--radius-4xl, 1.625rem); background: var(--primary, oklch(0.5 0.155 175)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.985 0.003 175)); font: 500 0.75rem/1rem var(--font-sans, "Geist Variable", sans-serif); } .ds-badge:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, oklch(0.5 0.155 175)) 80%, transparent); } .ds-badge:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring, oklch(0.6 0.16 175)) 50%, transparent); }

narrative.overview: This app is rendered by the Sovrium binary from its configuration, on shadcn/ui base-nova on Base UI, set in Geist unless its `design` key names another face.
dos: **Do** change a colour, radius, spacing step or type rung in the app's `design` key, then regenerate this file.
**Do** adjust one element through its `classes` or `className`, with the token utilities this file names.
**Do** build pages from shadcn/ui components, by their shadcn names.
**Do** refer to colours, radii and spacing by the token names in the front matter.
donts: **Don't** write a CSS, HTML or font file: the Sovrium binary renders every page and does not load one.
**Don't** invent a new visual world: this app is shadcn/ui base-nova on Base UI.
**Don't** paste a literal colour or size into a page: name its token.
**Don't** edit this file outside its narrative blocks: the next export rewrites it.
